input.summary: Add numbered Paragraph 4.10 giving a 90-day Wet Segment/software conformance warranty, a 30-day services warranty and repair/replacement or refund remedies, and carve it out of both the liability exclusion and the warranty disclaimer in Paragraph 4.9.
input.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 4.9 both excludes PG liability for APCN 2 failing to meet the Supply Contract specifications and disclaims all warranties, which is our walk-away position, so we have added Paragraph 4.10 with a short fallback conformance warranty (90 days for the Wet Segment and its software against its documentation, 30 days for services) and repair, replacement or refund as the remedy. We have carved Paragraph 4.10 out of the liability exclusion as well as the disclaimer so the remedy is not swallowed by the retained language.

ops.oldText: 4.9 The members of the PG shall not be liable to any other Party or to each other for any loss or damage
ops.newText: 4.9 Except as provided in Paragraph 4.10, the members of the PG shall not be liable to any other Party or to each other for any loss or damage

ops.oldText: The Parties recognize and agree that the PG does not make any representations or warranties, including, but not limited to, any representation or warranty regarding:
ops.newText: Except for the warranties expressly given in Paragraph 4.10, the Parties recognize and agree that the PG does not make any representations or warranties, including, but not limited to, any representation or warranty regarding:

ops.oldText: and the Parties hereby agree that nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee.
ops.newText: and the Parties hereby agree that, except as provided in Paragraph 4.10, nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as such a warranty or guarantee.

ops.text: 4.10 The PG warrants that (a) for a period of ninety (90) days following the RFPA Date, the Wet Segment and any software delivered with it will conform to its documentation and to the technical specifications and other requirements of the Supply Contract, and (b) for a period of thirty (30) days following their performance, services performed by the PG under this Agreement will conform to the requirements of this Agreement. For breach of this warranty the PG shall, as the affected Party elects, repair or replace the non-conforming Wet Segment, software or services, or refund the amounts paid by that Party in respect of the non-conforming item.
